settings.headline: About the board
settings.subtitle: Five elected directors (story), public meetings on the second Tuesday, and a budget that fits on two pages. Agendas and minutes live under Board meetings.

settings.headline: Who runs Carrow Bend Water
settings.body:
The fictional district serves about 4,800 connections (story) from the Ossel River treatment plant and two wells. Directors serve staggered four-year terms; the general manager and licensed operators are staff, not board members.

Rate changes require a posted hearing — the 2025 hearing story is summarized in the December 2025 minutes.
settings.side: Budgets, audits and the annual quality report are public records in the story. This demo publishes meetings and quality reports as structured content so they are searchable, not scanned sideways PDFs.
